History, persistence and portable export
|
|-- [O] DiagramService: sole writer of immutable content revisions
|-- [O] CanvasHistoryService owns contexts and histories
|   |-- Retained checkpoints + diagram revision bindings
|   |-- baseline / current head / undo and redo paths
|   |-- [D] document + view + correspondence
|   |   `-- checkpoint binds layout to exact diagram revisions
|   |-- [C] Controller undo / redo / reset delegate navigation
|   |   `-- [D] context + target checkpoint -> restored state
|   `-- [C] exportHistory / forkHistory -> exportContext / forkContext
|       `-- [O] Fork: distinct context, retained revision IDs
|
|-- [M] WorkspacePersistence: incremental autosave
|   |-- [C] Session commits -> workspace.onPersist(documentIds)
|   |   `-- Changed document IDs select persistence work
|   |-- [C] Also observes SourcePaneViewState changes
|   `-- [C] controller.persistenceChanges(cursor)
|       |-- [D] retained records + cursor -> incremental changes
|       `-- [C] RecordStorage.batch(changes)
|-- [O] WorkspaceStorage
|   |-- Owns RecordStorage: cached records + pending writes
|   `-- Owns workspaceStorage.worker
|       `-- [C] Encode / transport / restore records
|
`-- [M] capture(): MappingWorkspaceSnapshot
    |-- [D] workspace identity + active document + transfers
    |   `-- schemaVersion / projectId / activeDocumentId / transfers
    `-- [D] each open document -> MappingDocumentSnapshot
        |-- identity / name / saved baselines / revisionId / hidden
        |-- document / interaction state / viewport
        `-- [C] controller.exportHistory()
            `-- Portable history with revision tables and bindings

Context lifetime belongs to the history service, despite controller retention.
The seed does not specify flush timing or storage failure recovery.
